description: Hi! We are Code X, Code X is a high-achieving, ambitious Year 5/Grade 4 team from The Winchester School, Jebel Ali, combining advanced web development expertise with proven student leadership and seamless co-coordination experience to confidently secure 1st place in the NASA Space Apps Challenge.
summary:
CODE X — OUR STORY 🚀

We are Code X, with one big idea: what if kids could experience becoming astronauts?

Our Junior Astronaut Space Station lets children learn about space, explore spacecraft and practise flying through rocket simulators. They can take a test to become Junior Astronauts.

OUR TEAM

We are five 10-year-olds with different skills and personalities. We sometimes disagree, but we keep trying. Teamwork means bringing our talents together.

Zubin Sevlani – Team Captain
I live in Dubai and enjoy business, coding, technology, cricket, cycling and YouTube. I suggested connecting a web app with Minecraft Education. I help bring ideas together.

Kyansh Dobhal
A proud Indian who loves basketball and brings ideas to our team.

Reyansh Singh
One of my best friends! He enjoys cricket and football. He says he's good at cricket, but obviously I'm better! 😂

Mustafa Ezziladin
Our Egyptian teammate who enjoys Jiu-Jitsu and football.

Manahil
Our Minecraft expert, always ready to help us.

WHY CODE X?

We aren't perfect, and our project isn't finished. But we shared ideas, made mistakes, learned and kept going. Our teamwork gives us a chance.

THANK YOU

Thank you to our ICT teacher, Ms. Minakshi, our parents and God for their guidance and support.

OUR FINAL MESSAGE

We may be young, but we have big ideas. You don't have to be perfect to achieve something meaningful. Start, learn and keep going.

We didn't just build a project. We built a team.

WE ARE CODE X! 🚀
